name: What factors influence the cost of cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of cabinet installation is influenced by several factors, including the type of cabinets (stock, semi-custom, or custom), the complexity of the design, and the size of the area. Custom cabinets generally incur higher installation costs due to their unique specifications and fitting requirements. Additional factors like appliance integration, island installation, special hardware, and any necessary site preparation or modifications will also affect the overall price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
